description: This file contains CMake macros for checking build requirements and setting up test resources related to libwebsockets build configuration.

methods.name: require_lws_config
methods.description: Checks if the specified libwebsockets build configuration (reqconfig) matches the current build configuration.

methods.name: require_pthreads
methods.description: Checks for the presence of pthreads support and sets relevant variables.

methods.name: sai_resource
methods.description: Creates test resources with specified lease times and scopes, conditioned on an environment variable.
